basic_details.project_name: Proposed Bulk Drug Intermediates Manufacturing Unit
basic_details.proponent_name: M/s Apex Life Sciences Private Limited

statutory.appraisal_stage: Terms of Reference (ToR) for EIA/EMP study

litigation.court_cases: The project proponent affirms under oath that no litigation, public interest writ petition, court case, contempt petition, or National Green Tribunal (NGT) order is pending or has been instituted against the proposed synthetic organic chemicals manufacturing unit or against the project land as on date.
litigation.public_complaints: No public complaints received. The project is situated inside an approved industrial estate.

land_breakup.particular: Utility Area (Boiler, DG sets, Chilling Plant)

siting_criteria.nearest_railway_station: Patancheru Railway Station at 12.5 km, East
siting_criteria.nearest_airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA) at 52.0 km, South-East
siting_criteria.notified_industrial_area: TSIIC Pashamylaram Industrial Park (Notified under EIA 2006)
siting_criteria.general_conditions: Not applicable; project is located inside approved industrial estate and > 10 km from interstate boundary

manufacturing_process.summary: Multi-step organic synthesis involving Nitration, Ammonolysis, Condensation, and Controlled Crystallization with in-house solvent distillation.

streams.stream_name: High COD / High TDS Process Effluent
streams.treatment_scheme: Neutralization -> Stripper -> Multiple Effect Evaporator (MEE) -> ATFD

streams.stream_name: Low COD / Low TDS Washings & Blowdowns
streams.treatment_scheme: Equalization -> Primary Clarifier -> Biological Aeration -> Dual Media Filter -> Two Stage RO
Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor (MBBR) Package STP -> 100% reused for on-site greenbelt

flue_gas_stacks.apcm: Multi-Cyclone Dust Collector followed by Bag Filter
Acoustic Enclosure with CPCB compliant exhaust stack

process_gas_vents.apcm: Two-Stage Counter-Current Alkali Packed Bed Scrubber
Dilute Acid Wet Scrubber to produce Ammonium Salt solution

ldar_plan: Quarterly monitoring of 100% components (valves, pumps, flanges) using portable VOC/FID analyzer (US EPA Method 21).
Installation of double mechanical seals with barrier fluid systems on all solvent transfer pumps.
Closed loop sampling ports to prevent fugitive solvent vapor release during quality testing.
Nitrogen blanketing provided for all bulk solvent storage tanks with vent condensers maintained at -15°C.

hazardous_waste.storage_method: Dedicated covered shed with impervious concrete floor & leachate collection
hazardous_waste.disposal_pathway: Disposal to authorized TSDF (Hyderabad Waste Management Project, Dundigal)

hazardous_waste.storage_method: HDPE bags in covered hazardous waste storage shed
Epoxy coated MS drums in shed
hazardous_waste.disposal_pathway: Co-processing in authorized Cement Kiln as alternate fuel (AFR)

hazardous_waste.storage_method: Underground solvent tanks with flame arrestors
hazardous_waste.disposal_pathway: In-house recovery (fractional distillation) with > 90% recovery; residue to co-processing

hazardous_waste.waste_description: Used Oil from DG Sets & Gearboxes
hazardous_waste.storage_method: Dedicated leak-proof drums in designated utility shed
hazardous_waste.disposal_pathway: Sale to CPCB/SPCB authorized re-refiners / recyclers

non_hazardous_waste.disposal: Supplied to local fly-ash brick manufacturers

non_hazardous_waste.waste_name: Used Paper, Packing Materials & Wooden Pallets

non_hazardous_waste.disposal: Segregated organic waste to in-vessel organic composter; dry waste to municipal collection

chemical_storage.safety_provisions: Nitrogen blanketing, flame arrestor, dyke wall capacity 110%, high level audio-visual alarm
Flame arrestor, double mechanical pump seal, dedicated foam deluge system

chemical_storage.storage_type: Above-ground SS-304 Tank in Acid Dyke
chemical_storage.safety_provisions: Acid resistant tile dyke, eye wash shower within 5m, neutralizing lime pit

general_safety: Process Safety Management (PSM) and HAZOP study conducted for all exothermic nitration and chlorination reactions.
Automated reactor interlocks: High-temperature cut-off, automated chilled water dump, rupture disc with bursting alarm.
Flameproof (FLP Ex-d) electrical fittings and static grounding loops installed across all solvent handling zones.
Comprehensive PPE matrix: Gas masks, chemical suits, face shields, and self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA).

fire_protection.pumping_capacity: 2 x 2850 LPM Main Electric Pumps + 1 x 2850 LPM Standby Diesel Pump
fire_protection.hydrant_network: Dedicated fire hydrant ring loop around all production blocks with 28 hydrant posts
fire_protection.foam_systems: Fixed semi-automatic foam pourers for all flammable solvent storage tanks with 1000 L AFFF foam concentrate
fire_protection.gas_detection: LEL sensors for solvent vapors and toxic gas detectors (Cl2, NH3) tied to central alarm panel
fire_protection.peso_compliance: Application submitted for PESO prior approval for bulk Class A & B solvent tank farms

nearest_fire_station.mutual_aid: Mutual aid agreement with neighboring TSIIC Pashamylaram member chemical industries

msihc_undertaking.rules_applicable: Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemical (MSIHC) Rules, 1989 (as amended)
msihc_undertaking.undertaking_text: The proponent declares that storage of hazardous chemicals is within declared limits and on-site emergency plan is prepared.

Hazardous Waste Storage Shed & Spill Containment
